priorityList: Enter Cat Form and Prowl before combat.
Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown, ensuring it is active before using major cooldowns or builders.
Cast Rake from Prowl or Shadowmeld to apply an empowered bleed to start combat.
Cast Ravage (Chomp) whenever the Chomp Enabler buff is active.
Use Ferocious Bite immediately when Apex Predator's Craving procs.
Activate Berserk or Incarnation: King of the Jungle while Tiger's Fury is active.
Cast Feral Frenzy or Frantic Frenzy when at 2 or fewer Combo Points while Tiger's Fury is active.
Use Convoke the Spirits while Tiger's Fury is active, preferably after a finisher when at 0-2 Combo Points.
Spend 4 or more Combo Points on Rip if the bleed is refreshable and Tiger's Fury is active.
Spend 5 Combo Points on Ferocious Bite as your primary finisher.
Use Shadowmeld to refresh Rake if it is refreshable to benefit from the stealth damage bonus.
Maintain Rake on the target, refreshing when it has less than 4 seconds remaining.
Maintain Moonfire on the target if talented into Lunar Inspiration.
Use Shred as your primary builder to generate Combo Points.
Use Regrowth with Predatory Swiftness procs if configured for survival or Bloodtalons maintenance.
